summary: Yes is a fist (S handshape) nodding at the wrist, like a head nodding. Nod your actual head along with it.
movement: Bends at the wrist, like nodding
steps: Make a fist with the thumb across the front of the fingers.
Hold it up and bend it forward at the wrist, once or twice, as if the fist is nodding.
note: For a casual 'yeah,' a single head nod with no hand sign is enough and very common.
mistakes: Moving the whole arm. The motion is at the wrist only.

faq.q: Can I just nod instead of signing YES?
faq.a: Yes. A nod while repeating the key sign (HUNGRY with a nod means 'yes, I'm hungry') is normal ASL.
